title: White Dwarf
definition: A white dwarf is the extremely dense stellar remnant left over by the collapse of a low-to-intermediate-mass star (below approximately 8 solar masses) after it has exhausted its nuclear fuel.
importanceInUpsc: Tested in UPSC CSE Prelims under Science & Technology (Space Physics, Astrophysics) through concepts like electron degeneracy pressure, Chandrasekhar limit, and cosmological distance indicators.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of White Dwarf.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
